name: allow
title_zh: 改规则级别不用求人，直接编辑 .anchorwatc
tagline_zh: 规则太严拦了正常提交，太松放了危险改动？不用改代码、不用重启流程。
tagline_en: Guardrail too strict or too loose? No code changes needed—edit a JSON field to switch block/warn/off, add allow.
desc_en: Configure Anchorwatch — change a rule's level (block/warn/off), add an allow pattern, or set protected branches by editing .anchorwatch.json. Use when a guardrail is too strict or too loose for this project.
why_zh: 把策略决策从代码里拆出来，变成项目内可审阅的配置文件。改规则像改配置一样轻。
why_en: Policy lives in a reviewable config file, not buried in code. Changes are as light as editing JSON, yet every tweak stays in git.
limit_zh: 只认 .anchorwatch.json 这一种配置源；不读 YAML/TOML。只调规则级别、白名单。
limit_en: Only reads .anchorwatch.json (no YAML/TOML). Only adjusts rule levels, allow patterns, and protected branches—no new rule logic. Re-run anchorwatch.
